scope: Forward actual Workspace active-window menu metadata to the shared native host

implementation.metadata: WSShellConnection binds protocol 19, merges window_appmenu into complete compositor batches and selects the focused native Wayland window.
implementation.role: Optional inherited Unix SEQPACKET role is consumed before AppKit helpers and marked CLOEXEC. Workspace window-manager lifetime owns the connection.
implementation.scheduling: Native run-loop descriptor callbacks, nonblocking sends and one pending acknowledgement. Focus changes coalesce; geometry-only changes do not rebind.
implementation.rejection: Failed current address clears stale menu and caches rejected identity to prevent native-window mapping retry loops. Changed selection may be tried.
implementation.separation: No widget drawing, layout, native shortcut interpretation or native component copy. Existing helper authenticates D-Bus owner and uses NativeUI/GNUstep menus.
implementation.qualification_boundary: Private probe links the actual production connection classes. Workspace main/window-manager compile syntax is checked; full Workspace deployment and standard session host startup remain open.

remaining: Standard session launch/packaging/supervision of the shared host and its private role; full installed Workspace application deployment is not qualified.
Browser global native menu keyboard routing outside native text fields. The page-body Alt+T failure is retained; successful association checks explicitly focus the native address field.
Production registrar, bus recovery and retry policy for previously rejected addresses.
Other browser controls/dialogs, special-key/multi-chord menu metadata, IME, accessibility and mixed scaling.
Chrome/Vivaldi/Firefox derivative frontends and complete GTK/Qt/KDE application integration.
